<!-- One key number of StatsBand: a card (StatTile), or the value over its label, optionally under a Lucide icon. -->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Stat } from "../blocks/stats-band.types";

export type StatFigureProps = {
  stat: Stat;
  item?: "plain" | "card" | "icon";
  align?: "start" | "center";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import StatTile from "../components/stat-tile.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn } from "../utils";

</script>

<template>
  <StatTile
    v-if="((item as string) === 'card')"
    :label="stat.label"
    :value="stat.value"
    :icon="stat.icon"
    :hint="stat.hint"
  />
  <Stack v-else
    gap="6"
    :align="(((align as string) === 'center') ? 'center' : 'start')"
    :class="cn((((align as string) === 'center') ? 'text-center' : ''), defaults.stats.column)"
    data-testid="item"
  >
    <LucideIcon v-if="((item as string) === 'icon')" :name="stat.icon" :size="24" />
    <Stack gap="2" :align="(((align as string) === 'center') ? 'center' : 'start')">
      <Text size="5xl" weight="medium" :class="cn('flex items-center', defaults.stats.figure)">
        {{ stat.value }}
      </Text>
      <Text size="sm" weight="semibold" class="leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        {{ stat.label }}
      </Text>
    </Stack>
  </Stack>
</template>
